requirements.text: A valid sales_manager order creation request returns HTTP 201 with code CREATED.
Each order line quantity is an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive; quantities 0 and 101 are rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The viewer role is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.

sources: src/orders/api.py — POST /api/v1/orders returns 201 CREATED for a valid sales_manager request
src/orders/service.py — rejects quantities 0 and 101 with 422 QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE
